name: Alien-Trade Thesis Check (Falsification-as-a-Service)
description: Given a free-text trading idea, returns whether it was VALIDATED or FALSIFIED in honest walk-forward + holdout testing against Alien-Trade's thesis ledger — with the out-of-sample objective (Sortino - 2*maxDD), the deflated Sharpe ratio (multiplicity-adjusted, Lopez de Prado), and the exact source citation (interview/article). The falsification log is the differentiator: it tells you what does NOT work and why.
author: alien-trade

idea_text.description: A free-text trading idea/thesis to check against the ledger, e.g. 'momentum works in confirmed uptrends' or 'rotate into the strongest asset'.

source.description: Exact citation for the matched thesis.

matched_claim.description: The ledger claim that matched the idea.
